reason: Reviewed lifecycle-hook guidance, the Notifai skill and its notes and native-question references, harness setup, CLI readiness, and domain/trust terms against the Claude Code wake change. Claude Code drops a peer message identical to one it received shortly before, so the fixed wake sentence could be accepted and never shown, leaving later notes and answers without a wake. Each Claude wake now carries its own token, using the tokenised wake sentence Codex sessions already receive, is settled only by that token, and is replaced once if it stays unshown in an idle session. The prompt hook recognises that tokenised wake as a wake for Claude Code only; Codex prompts keep their existing path. The skill already tells agents to run notifai receive when a wake names it and that hooks may have delivered the input already, which matches the tokenised sentence. No command, flag, setup step, trust decision, question identity or acknowledgement obligation changes, so no guidance edit is required.
